list.name: stage_owner
list.label: Stage owner
list.description: Team that owns the stage an idle GPU waits in. All = no filter (also keeps rows with no owner).
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT stage_owner FROM capacity_intervals WHERE stage_owner IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT stage_owner FROM capacity_intervals WHERE stage_owner IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.description: Site from assets.site; assets with no site appear as '(none)'. All = no site filter.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(site, '(none)') FROM assets ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(site, '(none)') FROM assets ORDER BY 1

list.name: snapshot
list.label: Price snapshot (USD)
list.description: AWS On-Demand pricing snapshot for present-day value. Default: the engine's selection (TTV_PRICING_SNAPSHOT, else the latest published). Historical value always uses, per interval, the snapshot in force when the interval started.
list.query:
SELECT s.snapshot_id FROM pricing_snapshots s
LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST, s.captured_at DESC
list.definition:
SELECT s.snapshot_id FROM pricing_snapshots s
LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST, s.captured_at DESC

panels.title: Idle GPUs
panels.description:
Definition: GPUs in open IDLE intervals (the latest engine scan), all stage owners together; the queue table splits them by owner.
Filters: site, stage_owner.
Unknown vs zero: UNKNOWN GPUs are never counted here; 'no GPUs in scope' before the first scan or when the site filter matches no GPU.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce((
  SELECT sum(i.gpus)
  FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))), 0) END AS "Idle GPUs"

panels.title: Idle value / hour (AWS)
panels.description:
Definition: what the idle GPUs now would cost per hour at AWS On-Demand rates (Linux, shared tenancy) from the selected price snapshot, shown under the value. A comparison, not a bill, not our cost and not a loss (ADR-0003).
'at least' means some idle GPUs have no price (their model has no rate) and are left out; Queues lists them. The line above the value names the snapshot's region and price date.
Filters: site, stage_owner, snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(i.gpus), 0) AS gpus,
         sum(i.gpus * r.per_gpu_hour_usd) AS usd,
         coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE r.per_gpu_hour_usd IS NULL), 0) AS unpriced
  FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
), s AS (
  SELECT region || ', ' || to_char(publication_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS label
  FROM pricing_snapshots WHERE snapshot_id = '${snapshot}'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s) THEN coalesce(v.usd, CASE WHEN v.gpus = 0 THEN 0 END) END AS usd,
       coalesce((SELECT label FROM s), 'no price snapshot')
       || CASE WHEN v.unpriced > 0 THEN ' · at least (' || v.unpriced || ' GPUs unpriced)' ELSE '' END AS label
FROM v

panels.title: Productive share
panels.description:
Definition: PRODUCTIVE GPUs ÷ (PRODUCTIVE + IDLE GPUs) now. NOT_CHARGED (approved exclusions, clusters outside the target list) and UNKNOWN GPUs are outside the denominator, so check 'Unknown GPUs' before reading this.
Filters: site (stage_owner does not apply: productive GPUs have no stage owner).

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'PRODUCTIVE') AS productive,
         sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category IN ('PRODUCTIVE', 'IDLE')) AS eligible
  FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
)
SELECT CASE WHEN eligible > 0 THEN 100.0 * coalesce(productive, 0) / eligible END AS "Productive share"
FROM g

panels.title: Unknown GPUs
panels.description:
Definition: GPUs in open UNKNOWN intervals: a stale or failing source, an identity conflict, a cluster not observed, a node not found, missing telemetry. Never counted as idle or productive; Evidence explains each reason.
Filters: site.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce((
  SELECT sum(i.gpus) FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'UNKNOWN' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))), 0) END AS "Unknown GPUs"

panels.title: Not measured
panels.description:
Definition: GPUs installed in clusters outside the target list (OUTSIDE_TARGET_CLUSTERS, input I7): visible, not charged to anyone, and not measured for use.
Filters: site.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce((
  SELECT sum(i.gpus) FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.reason_code = 'OUTSIDE_TARGET_CLUSTERS' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))), 0) END AS "Not measured GPUs"

panels.title: Data age
panels.description:
Definition: time since the newest engine scan that finished ok or partial. Every 'now' number on this page is as of that scan. Green within 15 min (3 scans), orange within 1 h, red beyond.
Filters: none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(finished_at)) AS "Data age"
FROM scan_runs
WHERE status IN ('ok', 'partial') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Stage queues now (pipeline order)
panels.description:
Definition: the four handoff queues in pipeline order. Per stage owner: idle GPUs now; overdue GPUs (idle past the stage objective of the interval's own policy version); servers waiting; the oldest wait among their current stage episodes; the objective; the idle value per hour at the selected snapshot; and the reason holding the most GPUs.
'≥' marks waits that began before observation (minimums). Value '≥' means some GPUs are unpriced.
Filters: site (all four owners always show; stage_owner does not apply).

targets.rawSql:
WITH owners(owner, ord) AS (VALUES ('DC', 1), ('Redbull', 2), ('POPAI', 3), ('Serving', 4)),
iv AS (
  SELECT i.stage_owner, i.asset_id, i.stage_entered_at, i.stage_entered_lower_bound AS lb, i.gpus, i.reason_code,
         o.objective, r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
  FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
), ep AS (
  SELECT stage_owner, asset_id, stage_entered_at, bool_or(lb) AS lb
  FROM iv GROUP BY stage_owner, asset_id, stage_entered_at
), agg AS (
  SELECT stage_owner,
         sum(gpus) AS gpus,
         coalesce(sum(gpus) FILTER (WHERE objective IS NOT NULL AND now() > stage_entered_at + objective), 0) AS overdue,
         max(extract(epoch FROM objective)) / 86400 AS objective_d,
         sum(gpus * rate) AS usd,
         coalesce(sum(gpus) FILTER (WHERE rate IS NULL), 0) AS unpriced
  FROM iv GROUP BY stage_owner
), waits AS (
  SELECT stage_owner, count(*) AS servers, bool_or(lb) AS lb,
         max(extract(epoch FROM now() - stage_entered_at)) / 86400 AS oldest_d,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM now() - stage_entered_at)) / 86400 AS median_d
  FROM ep GROUP BY stage_owner
), top_reason AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (stage_owner) stage_owner, reason_code
  FROM (SELECT stage_owner, reason_code, sum(gpus) AS g FROM iv GROUP BY 1, 2) x
  ORDER BY stage_owner, g DESC, reason_code
)
SELECT ow.owner AS "Stage owner",
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce(g.gpus, 0) END AS "Idle GPUs",
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce(g.overdue, 0) END AS "Overdue GPUs",
       w.servers AS "Servers",
       CASE WHEN w.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END || to_char(w.oldest_d, 'FM99990.0') || ' d' AS "Oldest wait",
       to_char(g.objective_d, 'FM9990.##') || ' d' AS "Objective",
       CASE WHEN g.gpus IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN g.usd IS NULL THEN 'unpriced'
            ELSE CASE WHEN g.unpriced > 0 THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END || '$' || to_char(g.usd, 'FM999,999,990') END AS "Idle value / h",
       t.reason_code AS "Main reason"
FROM owners ow
LEFT JOIN agg g ON g.stage_owner = ow.owner
LEFT JOIN waits w ON w.stage_owner = ow.owner
LEFT JOIN top_reason t ON t.stage_owner = ow.owner
ORDER BY ow.ord

panels.title: Every GPU by category now
panels.description:
Definition: all GPUs in the ledger now, split into the four mutually exclusive categories (each GPU counts once). Productive = doing useful work; Idle = waiting in a stage queue; Not charged = approved exclusion or outside the target clusters; Unknown = not enough evidence.
Filters: site.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'PRODUCTIVE'), 0) AS "Productive",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'IDLE'), 0) AS "Idle",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'NOT_CHARGED'), 0) AS "Not charged",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'UNKNOWN'), 0) AS "Unknown"
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
HAVING count(*) > 0

panels.title: Longest waits now
panels.description:
Definition: the 10 current idle stage episodes that have waited longest (one row per asset and stage episode). 'Idle GPU-h' sums the episode's idle intervals from their start to now; 'Value' prices them at the selected snapshot (present-day rates).
'≥' = the stage began before observation, so since, days, GPU-h and value are minimums. Next-action owner is display only (never moves totals); empty = no annotation.
Filters: site, stage_owner. The full list is on Queues.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_owner, i.stage_entered_at, bool_or(i.stage_entered_lower_bound) AS lb,
         sum(i.gpus) AS gpus, string_agg(DISTINCT i.reason_code, ', ') AS reasons
  FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
  GROUP BY i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_owner, i.stage_entered_at
  ORDER BY now() - i.stage_entered_at DESC NULLS FIRST, sum(i.gpus) DESC, i.asset_id
  LIMIT 10
), ep AS (
  SELECT c.asset_id, c.stage, c.stage_entered_at,
         sum(i.gpus * extract(epoch FROM coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) - i.started_at)) / 3600 AS gpu_h,
         sum(i.gpus * extract(epoch FROM coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) - i.started_at) * r.per_gpu_hour_usd) / 3600 AS usd,
         bool_or(r.per_gpu_hour_usd IS NULL) AS any_unpriced
  FROM cur c
  JOIN capacity_intervals i ON i.asset_id = c.asset_id AND i.category = 'IDLE'
   AND i.stage IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage AND i.stage_entered_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage_entered_at
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  GROUP BY c.asset_id, c.stage, c.stage_entered_at
)
SELECT c.asset_id AS "Asset",
       a.name AS "Server",
       c.stage_owner AS "Stage owner",
       c.reasons AS "Reason",
       c.gpus AS "Idle GPUs",
       coalesce(CASE WHEN c.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END || to_char(extract(epoch FROM now() - c.stage_entered_at) / 86400, 'FM99990.0') || ' d', 'unknown') AS "Waiting",
       CASE WHEN c.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END || to_char(ep.gpu_h, 'FM9,999,990') AS "Idle GPU-h",
       CASE WHEN ep.usd IS NULL THEN 'unpriced'
            ELSE CASE WHEN c.lb OR ep.any_unpriced THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END || '$' || to_char(ep.usd, 'FM9,999,990') END AS "Value (USD)",
       na.next_action_owner AS "Next-action owner"
FROM cur c
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = c.asset_id
LEFT JOIN ep ON ep.asset_id = c.asset_id AND ep.stage IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage
            AND ep.stage_entered_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage_entered_at
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT n.next_action_owner FROM next_action_annotations n
  WHERE n.asset_id = c.asset_id AND n.expires_at > now()
  ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT 1
) na ON true
ORDER BY now() - c.stage_entered_at DESC NULLS FIRST, c.gpus DESC, c.asset_id

panels.title: Installed GPUs by model: in service or waiting (E01, partial)
panels.description:
Definition: every GPU in the ledger now, by GPU model (canonical name when the pricing catalogue recognises it, else as reported), split by category. Answers the inventory half of E01; purchase and receipt dates need procurement records, which R1 does not have ('input missing').
Filters: site.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(ga.canonical, i.gpu_model, '(model not reported)') AS "GPU model",
       sum(i.gpus) AS "GPUs",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'PRODUCTIVE'), 0) AS "Productive",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'IDLE'), 0) AS "Idle",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'NOT_CHARGED'), 0) AS "Not charged",
       coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'UNKNOWN'), 0) AS "Unknown",
       'input missing' AS "Purchased / received"
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

panels.title: Selected period: idle and overdue time
Idle GPU-hours in period
panels.description:
Definition: Σ GPUs × hours of IDLE intervals clipped to the selected time range (open intervals end at now). AGENT.md §17: 6 idle GPUs for 2 h = 12 GPU-h.
Filters: site, stage_owner, time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1),
iv AS (
  SELECT i.gpus,
         greatest(i.started_at, w.t0) AS s,
         least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) AS e,
         CASE WHEN o.objective IS NULL OR i.stage_entered_at IS NULL THEN NULL
              ELSE greatest(i.started_at, i.stage_entered_at + o.objective, w.t0) END AS os,
         r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  CROSS JOIN w
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce(sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM e - s)) / 3600, 0) END AS "Idle GPU-h" FROM iv

panels.title: Overdue GPU-hours in period
panels.description:
Definition: the part of each IDLE interval after stage_entered_at + the stage objective (of the interval's own policy version), clipped to the time range. AGENT.md §17: 8 GPUs idle 3 h with a 1 h objective = 24 idle, 16 overdue GPU-h. Intervals with no objective are excluded here (Queues shows them).
Filters: site, stage_owner, time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1),
iv AS (
  SELECT i.gpus,
         greatest(i.started_at, w.t0) AS s,
         least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) AS e,
         CASE WHEN o.objective IS NULL OR i.stage_entered_at IS NULL THEN NULL
              ELSE greatest(i.started_at, i.stage_entered_at + o.objective, w.t0) END AS os,
         r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  CROSS JOIN w
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce(sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM greatest(e - os, interval '0'))) FILTER (WHERE os IS NOT NULL) / 3600, 0) END AS "Overdue GPU-h" FROM iv

panels.title: Idle value in period (AWS)
panels.description:
Definition: idle GPU-hours in the time range × the per-GPU hourly rate of each GPU's model at the selected snapshot (present-day prices). 'at least' = some idle GPU-hours are unpriced and left out. A comparison, not a bill or a loss (ADR-0003). Queues also shows historical prices.
Filters: site, stage_owner, time range, snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1),
iv AS (
  SELECT i.gpus,
         greatest(i.started_at, w.t0) AS s,
         least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) AS e,
         CASE WHEN o.objective IS NULL OR i.stage_entered_at IS NULL THEN NULL
              ELSE greatest(i.started_at, i.stage_entered_at + o.objective, w.t0) END AS os,
         r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  CROSS JOIN w
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
)

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pricing_snapshots WHERE snapshot_id = '${snapshot}')
            THEN coalesce(sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM e - s) * rate) / 3600, CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 0 END) END AS usd,
       CASE WHEN bool_or(rate IS NULL) THEN 'at least · ' || to_char(sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM e - s)) FILTER (WHERE rate IS NULL) / 3600, 'FM9,999,990') || ' GPU-h unpriced'
            ELSE 'present-day prices' END AS label
FROM iv

panels.title: Idle GPUs over time, by stage owner
panels.description:
Definition: idle GPUs at each point in the time range, sampled from the ledger (an interval counts while it is open), stacked by stage owner in pipeline order; the red line is the overdue part (idle past the stage objective). Rising = queues growing. The chart starts at the first engine scan: there is no evidence before it.
Filters: site, stage_owner, time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()),
                         make_interval(secs => greatest($__interval_ms, 300000) / 1000.0)) AS t
), iv AS (
  SELECT t.t, i.stage_owner, i.gpus,
         (o.objective IS NOT NULL AND t.t > i.stage_entered_at + o.objective) AS overdue
  FROM t
  JOIN capacity_intervals i ON i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.started_at <= t.t AND (i.ended_at IS NULL OR i.ended_at > t.t)
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  WHERE ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
)
SELECT t.t AS time,
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.stage_owner = 'DC'), 0) AS "DC",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.stage_owner = 'Redbull'), 0) AS "Redbull",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.stage_owner = 'POPAI'), 0) AS "POPAI",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.stage_owner = 'Serving'), 0) AS "Serving",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.overdue), 0) AS "Overdue (all owners)"
FROM t
LEFT JOIN iv ON iv.t = t.t
WHERE t.t >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM scan_runs WHERE status IN ('ok', 'partial'))
GROUP BY t.t
ORDER BY t.t
